open_points.subject: M23 NodeExecution identity and references
open_points.text: Model M23 lists candidate fields `run_id`, `node_id`, `map_index`, `attempt_number` ... but no `node_execution_id`, while M06 says `captured_from`: "the NodeExecution (M23) it was captured from" and State 0 actions fail on "unknown reference".
open_points.question: What exact reference identifies one NodeExecution in product actions and records (especially capture-into-trial and inspect)?
options: NodeExecution is identified by the tuple (`run_id`,`node_id`,`map_index`,`attempt_number`)
NodeExecution gets its own minted identifier field
Both tuple and minted id are valid references
open_points.default_guess: Use the tuple as the stable identifier because those fields already appear as the attempt key.

open_points.subject: K-08 vs M26 authority for `draft-write` resend after `not_applied`
open_points.text: State 0 K-08: "a `draft-write` runs under the owner's activation of the flow instead" (no per-effect approval stop). M26: "except a resend after `not_applied`, which, whatever its class, records the fresh approval it needed".
open_points.question: If a `draft-write` attempt is resolved `not_applied`, must the resend require a fresh per-effect owner approval, or can it still run only under flow activation?
options: Resend of `draft-write` requires fresh per-effect approval
Resend of `draft-write` still uses flow activation only
Resend rule differs by whether a standing grant exists
open_points.default_guess: Require a fresh per-effect approval on resend after `not_applied` for all non-read classes, including `draft-write`.

open_points.subject: StandingGrant action effect on already-waiting approvals
open_points.text: State 0 action output says granting means "the node of that flow version stops asking"; M25 defines grant lifecycle but does not state what happens to existing `EffectApproval` records already in `requested` state for waiting run nodes.
open_points.question: When an owner grants a node while runs are already waiting for owner approval at that node, do those waiting points clear and proceed under the grant immediately, or does the run still require decisions on already-requested approvals?
options: Grant applies immediately to current waiting points and execution proceeds
Grant applies only to future attempts; existing requested approvals must still be decided
Grant applies immediately only if request_digest still matches current built request
open_points.default_guess: Apply grant immediately to current waiting points for that node/version and proceed without deciding old requested approvals.

open_points.subject: EffectApproval multiplicity per node attempt
open_points.text: M24 defines `approval_id` and statuses (`requested`, `approved`, `refused`, `used`) but gives no rule limiting how many approvals may exist for the same (`run_id`,`node_id`,`map_index`) and request/input set.
open_points.question: Can multiple `EffectApproval` records coexist for the same node attempt context, and if so which one is authoritative for send/decide actions?
options: At most one active (`requested`/`approved`) approval per node+map index at a time
Multiple approvals allowed; the latest matching `request_digest` is authoritative
Multiple approvals allowed; authority must be selected explicitly by `approval_id`
open_points.default_guess: Allow multiple historical approvals but treat only the latest matching unused approved record as usable authority.
